Citing

If you use this software or the methods it implements, please cite the accompanying paper:

A. Yousefi, C. T. Recchiuto, and A. Sgorbissa, Design and User Evaluation of an Immersive Teleoperation System for a Quadruped Robot.

Code: https://github.com/aliy98/immersive-spot-teleoperation

The user study (\(N = 30\)) compared this stack with the stock Spot tablet after matching field of view. Objective metrics were completion time and features identified per minute; subjective instruments were the Presence Questionnaire and the Simulator Sickness Questionnaire. Those results live in the paper, not in this repository.
